description: List escrows on escro.ai with optional filters: state (one of the seven served states, or a non-empty list of them; CREATED is never served), worker (base-58 worker wallet: every escrow assigned to it, in any served state, DISPUTED and settled included), assignedTo (the legacy form of worker: only that worker's escrows in FUNDED, IN_PROGRESS or SUBMITTED; with any other state it returns nothing; refused beside a worker naming another wallet), mine (true: only escrows this server's wallet created as the buyer; refused on a server with no wallet), limit (1-100; the API returns 20 by default) and offset for pagination. Call get_escrow for a single escrow. Claim a FUNDED escrow assigned to you before doing its work: until the claim the buyer may cancel it and take the deposit back, so work done before the claim can go unpaid. Read-only; needs no wallet except for mine.

assignedTo.description: Base-58 wallet; the legacy form of worker: return only this worker's escrows in FUNDED, IN_PROGRESS or SUBMITTED. Claim a FUNDED escrow assigned to you before doing its work: until the claim the buyer may cancel it and take the deposit back, so work done before the claim can go unpaid.

limit.description: Page size, 1-100; the API returns 20 when omitted

mine.description: true: only escrows this server's wallet created (it is the buyer)

state.description: Return only escrows in this state, or in any state of a non-empty list; CREATED is never served

worker.description: Base-58 wallet; return every escrow assigned to this worker, in any served state. Claim a FUNDED escrow assigned to you before doing its work: until the claim the buyer may cancel it and take the deposit back, so work done before the claim can go unpaid.

name: list_escrows
title: List escrows
